content.text: The Borders – Phan Tei|2 Day 1 Night
Last time, TodayTourist successfully hosted the tour program – the experience for students of the 12th block of the Rose Song School at the sea city of Phan Tei.
During their two-day and one-night journey, students were not only able to have fun, relax, but also had the opportunity to learn reality and explore many technology models – interesting history:
Visiting high-tech agriculture models at Peace Farm, learning about modern farming methods and organic agriculture.
Discovering the Red Air Power Plant 4, learns about renewable energy and advanced solar batteries in the world.
Visiting the history of the School of Education – which is associated with the time of teaching by the youth Hu Chi Minh.
Gala Dinner – The Art – The Group Games
Physical activity and beach hygiene for the environment
The journey not only brings pleasant moments, but also helps students to expand their knowledge, train their collective skills, and retain fond memories before leaving the school chair.
